words.gloss: even to the authors of treatises

literal: To those who are negligent there is no fame; that is the conclusion of the authors of treatises of whatever category in this world.
translation: There is no greatness or fame for those who are negligent; this is the unanimous conclusion of the scholars of every kind of treatise in the world.
modern: மறதி அல்லது சோம்பல் உடையவர்களுக்குப் புகழ் உண்டாவது இல்லை; அது உலகத்தில் உள்ள எந்த வகையான நூல்களை எழுதியவர்களுக்கும் துணிவான முடிவாகும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the absolute incompatibility of negligence (பொச்சாப்பு) and fame (புகழ்மை). The author states that those who act with forgetfulness or lack of vigilance can never acquire greatness. To reinforce this truth, the couplet asserts that this is not just a personal opinion, but the settled conclusion (துணிவு) of scholars of all kinds of treatises (எப்பால் நூலோர்க்கும்) across the world. The word 'பொச்சாப்பு' refers to a state of self-forgetful carelessness, which destroys any chance of lasting achievement.
